emissions = read_csv("data/jp_emissions.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(year == 2017, emissions > 0, pop > 0)

fit_data = emissions
m = fit_data %>% lm(formula = log(emissions) ~ log(pop) + log(income_per_capita))

set.seed(5460)
sims = MASS::mvrnorm(n = 1000, mu = coef(m), Sigma = vcov(m)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  setNames(c("b0", "b_pop", "b_income"))

qoi = sims %>%
  mutate(q = exp(b0 + b_pop * log(50000) + b_income * log(1200)))

analytic = predict(m, newdata = tibble(pop = 50000, income_per_capita = 1200),
  interval = "confidence") %>% exp()

qoi %>%
  summarize(n_fit = nrow(fit_data), n_sims = n(), sim_mean = mean(q),
            sim_lower = quantile(q, 0.025), sim_upper = quantile(q, 0.975))
